en: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
ar: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ

nb.en: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,

tr: An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

en: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
ar: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

nb.en: Because your Lord has commanded it.

tr: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum

en: And We had already destroyed generations before you when they wronged, and their messengers had come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe. Thus do We recompense the criminal people
ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا ٱلۡقُرُونَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَمَّا ظَلَمُواْ وَجَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَمَا كَانُواْ لِيُؤۡمِنُواْۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

nb.en: And when affliction touches man, he calls upon Us, whether lying on his side or sitting or standing; but when We remove from him his affliction, he continues [in disobedience] as if he had never called upon Us to [remove] an affliction that touched him. Thus is made pleasing to the transgressors that which they have been doing

tr: Walaqad ahlakna alquroona min qablikum lamma thalamoo wajaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati wama kanoo liyuminoo kathalika najzee alqawma almujrimeena

en: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
ar: قَالَتۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ أَفۡتُونِي فِيٓ أَمۡرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمۡرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشۡهَدُونِ

nb.en: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].' "

tr: Qalat ya ayyuha almalao aftoonee fee amree ma kuntu qatiAAatan amran hatta tashhadoona

en: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ

nb.en: Those are the companions of the right.

tr: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati

en: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
ar: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ

nb.en: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.

tr: Ma samiAAna bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun

en: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
ar: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

nb.en: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.' "

tr: Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma AAamiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

nb.en: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.

tr: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

en: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

nb.en: Does he not know that Allah sees?

tr: Kalla lain lam yantahi lanasfaAAan bialnnasiyati

en: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place.
ar: فَٱعۡلَمۡ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمۡ وَمَثۡوَىٰكُمۡ

nb.en: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then what good to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?

tr: FaiAAlam annahu la ilaha illa Allahu waistaghfir lithanbika walilmumineena waalmuminati waAllahu yaAAlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwakum

en: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when We saved you from the people of Pharaoh, [who were] afflicting you with the worst torment - killing your sons and keeping your women alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
ar: وَإِذۡ أَنجَيۡنَٰكُم مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَسُومُونَكُمۡ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يُقَتِّلُونَ أَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمۡۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ عَظِيمٞ

nb.en: He said, "Is it other than Allah I should desire for you as a god while He has preferred you over the worlds?"

tr: Waith anjaynakum min ali firAAawna yasoomoonakum sooa alAAathabi yuqattiloona abnaakum wayastahyoona nisaakum wafee thalikum balaon min rabbikum AAatheemun

en: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
ar: وَقَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

nb.en: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.

tr: Waqala noohun rabbi la tathar AAala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran

en: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
ar: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ

nb.en: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

tr: Ma waddaAAaka rabbuka wama qala

en: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.
ar: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٞ نَّفۡسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ إِن لَّمۡ يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا

nb.en: They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.

tr: FalaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka AAala atharihim in lam yuminoo bihatha alhadeethi asafan

en: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ

nb.en: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

tr: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona

en: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ

nb.en: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

tr: Inna lamma tagha almao hamalnakum fee aljariyati

en: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
ar: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

nb.en: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

tr: Araayta allathee yukaththibu bialddeeni

en: But whoever kills a believer intentionally - his recompense is Hell, wherein he will abide eternally, and Allah has become angry with him and has cursed him and has prepared for him a great punishment.
ar: وَمَن يَقۡتُلۡ مُؤۡمِنٗا مُّتَعَمِّدٗا فَجَزَآؤُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُ خَٰلِدٗا فِيهَا وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ وَلَعَنَهُۥ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُۥ عَذَابًا عَظِيمٗا

nb.en: And never is it for a believer to kill a believer except by mistake. And whoever kills a believer by mistake - then the freeing of a believing slave and a compensation payment presented to the deceased's family [is required] unless they give [up their right as] charity. But if the deceased was from a people at war with you and he was a believer - then [only] the freeing of a believing slave; and if he was from a people with whom you have a treaty - then a compensation payment presented to his family and the freeing of a believing slave. And whoever does not find [one or cannot afford to buy one] - then [instead], a fast for two months consecutively, [seeking] acceptance of repentance from Allah. And Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.

tr: Waman yaqtul muminan mutaAAammidan fajazaohu jahannamu khalidan feeha waghadiba Allahu AAalayhi walaAAanahu waaAAadda lahu AAathaban AAatheeman

en: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
ar: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـٔٗا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا

nb.en: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.

tr: Inna nashiata allayli hiya ashaddu watan waaqwamu qeelan

en: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
ar: أَمۡ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبٗاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيرِ

nb.en: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

tr: Am amintum man fee alssamai an yursila AAalaykum hasiban fasataAAlamoona kayfa natheeri

en: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرٖ فَأَسۡكَنَّـٰهُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابِۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ

nb.en: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.

tr: Waanzalna mina alssamai maan biqadarin faaskannahu fee alardi wainna AAala thahabin bihi laqadiroona

en: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا وَصَرَّفۡنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ أَوۡ يُحۡدِثُ لَهُمۡ ذِكۡرٗا

nb.en: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.

tr: Wakathalika anzalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan wasarrafna feehi mina alwaAAeedi laAAallahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum thikran

en: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
ar: أَتَّخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا أَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ

nb.en: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?

tr: Attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat AAanhumu alabsaru

en: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
ar: ۞وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ

nb.en: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

tr: Wakam min malakin fee alssamawati la tughnee shafaAAatuhum shayan illa min baAAdi an yathana Allahu liman yashao wayarda

en: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrong-doers.
ar: فَكَانَ عَٰقِبَتَهُمَآ أَنَّهُمَا فِي ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدَيۡنِ فِيهَاۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَـٰٓؤُاْ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

nb.en: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds."

tr: Fakana AAaqibatahuma annahuma fee alnnari khalidayni feeha wathalika jazao alththalimeena

en: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
ar: إِنَّآ أَعۡطَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡكَوۡثَرَ

nb.en: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].

tr: Inna aAAtaynaka alkawthara

en: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
ar: لَّقَدۡ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ ٱلذِّكۡرِ بَعۡدَ إِذۡ جَآءَنِيۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولٗا

nb.en: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.

tr: Laqad adallanee AAani alththikri baAAda ith jaanee wakana alshshaytanu lilinsani khathoolan

en: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
ar: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ

nb.en: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

tr: Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona

en: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ

nb.en: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?

tr: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli

en: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
ar: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارٗا

nb.en: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

tr: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran
